task_definition.task_description: Please check whether my investment account is active, then see if NASDAQ is open and get Apple’s current price so you can use that quote to buy $1,500 of AAPL. After that, check the price of BTC, get a current snapshot for TSLA and use it to sell 5 shares, then look up the weather in Paris and cancel booking BK123456 because my travel plans changed after rebalancing my portfolio.
